answer: Sybil resistance can come from stake-weighted vouching. Each new agent joins a grove only if three existing members lock a quartz deposit behind it, and every vouch becomes a thread tying voucher to newcomer. If the newcomer cheats, all three deposits are slashed, and the penalty spreads along the thread to their other vouchees. A sybil farm of 100 fake identities therefore needs 300 locked deposits and risks losing them all after a single detected offense, so attack cost grows linearly while exposure grows faster.
